question: Does Argon's FIRST_PRESQ entry (the first empty square of a name's day, 09:45-11:30 ET, day change +0.5..+5.0%, volume >= 1.5x, $20-$150) beat a later minute of the same name and a same-minute other name over the next 15 minutes, on sessions Argon never saw, in both halves, after cost?
operator_sentence: Operator 2026-10-27: 'Preregister Argon's FIRST_PRESQ (the vol 1.5x spec as stated) on held-out sessions: SIP days before 4/27 and after 10/15, with the pitch-study controls.'
registered_at: 2026-10-27 ~22:00 ET, before any held-out data is fetched or any script is written.

origin.claim: Gemini 4 Argon (report pasted by the operator 10/27), 119-120 warehouse sessions 2026-04-27..10-15, $20-$150: FIRST_PRESQ_morning_vol1.5x n 448, 15m gross +7.38 bp (median +2.88), halves +7.46 / +7.17, drop top 3 days +5.32; morning cohort lifts vs cross-name +11.80 and vs later minute +8.64; equal-weighted day mean +7.06 bp t +1.79. Argon reports SIP-gridded lines +10.10 bp and raw ungridded IEX -1.21 bp; gridded IEX was not reported.
origin.argon_code: Not found on the MacBook or the mini (searched 10/27). Every definition below is fixed here from the report's wording and, where the report is silent, from the desk's own definitions. If the operator supplies Argon's script before any held-out fetch, a declared amendment may align a definition to it; after the fetch, no definition changes.
origin.in_sample: 2026-04-27..2026-10-15 (the warehouse) is Argon's sample and is never scored here.

prior: Argon's in-sample lifts (+8.6 / +11.8 bp) are the best of 6 setups and several parameter bands, with day t 1.79, so expect shrinkage toward 0. Every %R-timing entry tested on the desk's data is ~0 (pitch studies 10/27, %R trend trade); a name/time-of-day selection is the kind of effect that has survived before (daily-context-picks-names). Honest prior for each lift: +2 +- 4 bp.

definitions.lines: The desk's lines, copied from tools/studies/pitch_open.py (not imported from live code): fast = Williams %R(21) then EMA span 7, slow = Williams %R(112) then EMA span 3, pandas ewm(adjust=False); in-session gaps of 2-15 minutes filled flat at the previous close (the live _minute_grid_pr fill); the previous session's RTH bars prepended as warm-up; a zero-range minute carries the EMA (as live and as pitch_open actually do).
definitions.empty_square: pitch_open.empty_square exactly: fast(t) >= -35 and slow(t) >= -35 and |fast - slow| <= 15, not (fast >= -20 and slow >= -20), and fast(t) > fast(t-1) + 0.05.
definitions.onset: An empty-square onset at minute t: empty_square(t) true and empty_square(t-1) false (t-1 missing = false). Minutes are read from 09:30.
definitions.first: FIRST = the name's first empty-square onset of the session counting from 09:30. If that first onset is before 09:45 or after 11:30, the name has no FIRST_PRESQ that day (counted). Argon's alternative 'or after a >= 45-60 min rest' is NOT part of the primary.
definitions.window: Signal minute t in 09:45..11:30 ET inclusive (minute-of-day 585..690).
definitions.day_change: close(t) / previous session's last RTH close - 1, on the same feed's split-adjusted warehouse bars, in [+0.5%, +5.0%] inclusive.
definitions.volume: vol_mult = v(t) / mean(v over t-15..t-1), same feed as the lines; requires all 15 prior minutes inside today's RTH (else no signal, counted); vol_mult >= 1.5. A zero mean = no signal.
definitions.universe: Every name in that held-out day's warehouse file (warehouse liquidity rule at fetch: prior RAW close >= $10, 20-day mean dollar volume >= $20M, ETFs/funds excluded).
definitions.one_per_name_day: At most one FIRST_PRESQ per name per day by construction.

feeds.IEX: Lines and volume on IEX bars (what the live desk sees). Co-primary.
feeds.SIP: Lines and volume on SIP bars (Argon's gridded-SIP claim). Co-primary.
feeds.fills: Both feeds fill and mark out on SIP bars.
feeds.reading: SIP PASS = Argon's claim replicates out of sample. IEX PASS = the desk can act on it today. Each feed is its own test.

entry_exit.entry: SIP open of t+1, > 0, else skipped and counted.
entry_exit.exit: SIP close of entry+14 (a 15-minute hold, Argon's 15m), > 0 and minute < 960, else skipped and counted. No exit rule, no stop.

controls: The pitch_open controls with HOLD 15: same seeded helper (wr_trend_trade.seeded with tags fp-d, fp-d2, fp-x, fp-x2 and entry_min = t+1). d = same name, one minute c drawn from entry+1..entry+60 with SIP open(c) > 0, close(c+14) > 0 and c+14 < 960; x = another SIP symbol that day (sorted list, the day's whole SIP file) with open(entry) > 0 and close(entry+14) > 0. d2 / x2 are the MDE draws.

data.held_out: SIP + IEX warehouse days fetched with tools/studies/warehouse_fetch.py --last 2026-01-13 --out ai_reports/warehouse_holdout, going BACKWARD from 2026-01-13 in blocks of 60 sessions; one extra warm-up session at the oldest end. 2026-01-14..04-24 is copied from ai_reports/warehouse_confirm and scored as its own information cell.
data.growth_rule: Outcome-blind: after each block, run the count step only (trades, days, MDE from control-minus-control2, no trade means). Stop adding blocks at the first block where both halves meet the floors for BOTH feeds, or at 600 sessions (back to about 2024-02), whichever comes first. The block count at which the floors were met is recorded before --score.
data.after_10_15: Sessions after 2026-10-15 need the liquidity table extended (ai_reports/gapdown/daily.pkl ends 10/15). They are NOT in the primary. Once the table is extended, they form a forward confirmation cell (information only, no pass).
data.halves: By count over scored held-out sessions in date order: half A = the older ceil(N/2), half B = the newer.

statistic: pitch_open's: per half, per day, mean over that day's trades of (trade gross - control gross); day-equal mean, t = mean / (stdev / sqrt(n_days)), ub = mean + t_ppf(0.975, n-1) * se. Net = day-equal mean of (gross - cost).
cost: 5 bp round trip is the grade (between the measured ~3 bp on $10+ names and the pitch studies' 10 bp; this is an entry test on $20+ names). 3 bp and 10 bp are information only.

power.floors: Per half, per feed: >= 150 trades, >= 40 days, MDE <= 6 bp for both control pairs, MDE = 2.84 * stdev(day means of control - control2) / sqrt(n_days).
power.underpowered: If floors are not met at 600 sessions, the verdict is UNDERPOWERED and no means are printed.

pass: Per feed, Bonferroni over 2 feeds (t >= 2.24). BOTH halves: lift_d >= +3 bp with t >= 2.24; lift_x >= +3 bp with t >= 2.24; day-equal net after 5 bp > 0; for each lift separately, dropping its 3 best days leaves its mean >= 0 and dropping its 5 largest-sum symbols leaves its mean >= 0.
fail: Any half with lift_d <= 0 or lift_x <= 0 is FAIL regardless of t. Anything else short of PASS is FAIL (or UNDERPOWERED under the power rule).
canary: Synthetic tests first (local): the onset, the first-of-day rule with a pre-window onset, the volume ratio, the day-change band, next-open entry, the 15-minute exit, and a +10 bp lift copy. On the rows: --canary adds 10 bp to every trade gross in a copy and prints only the change in net, lift_d, lift_x per half per feed; each within 1e-9 of +10 bp. --score refuses without canary_ok on the same module and prereg sha.
score_gate: --score refuses unless --skeptic-ready equals the 'ready' review_id recorded in this file AND the module sha and prereg sha match those recorded in count.json. No score before the growth rule has stopped.
information_only: Argon's best cell: 09:45-11:00, day change +1.0..+4.5%, vol >= 2.0x.
The live 9d83ca73 Leg-1 knobs: $25+, +1..+4%, <= 13:00, vol schedule 2.2x to 10:30, 1.8x to 11:30, 1.5x to 13:00.
FIRST_PRESQ AND the completed 5m-bar slow %R(28) pitch >= +2.0 (Argon's L1D wording).
Repeat (2nd+) empty-square onsets with the same filters (Argon's Leg 2+ comparison).
Net at 3 bp and 10 bp; 15m gross and median; by hour.
Forward cell after 10/15 once the liquidity table is extended.
no_retuning: No band, window, volume multiple or hold is scored as primary other than the one above. A PASS on an information cell earns nothing without its own prereg on forward data.
if_pass: result-skeptic Mode 3 review, then (IEX pass only) a live-desk prereg for the arm itself; a SIP-only pass is recorded as 'real on SIP, not tradable on the live feed' (sip-is-delayed-only).
if_fail: Leg-1 'first square' is closed as an entry edge; the live Leg-1 gate's knobs lose their claimed basis.
script: tools/studies/first_presq_holdout.py, written after this file is committed and after a result-skeptic READY; it may not change anything above. It copies pitch_open's line code and controls; pitch_open.py is not edited.
multiplicity: 2 primary tests (IEX, SIP), Bonferroni t >= 2.24. Information cells have no pass.

amended.when: 2026-10-27 ~18:15 ET, after result-skeptic round 1 FIX FIRST (findings A-H) and the operator's instruction, before any held-out fetch, any script, or any in-sample FIRST_PRESQ return.
amended.operator: 2026-10-27: 'Proceed without it [Argon's script] - I'm looking for the best configure that gives the most profit.' The study becomes two stages: an in-sample configuration search on Argon's sessions, then a held-out test of the chosen configuration only.

stage_1_search.sample: Argon's sample: the warehouse 2026-04-27..2026-10-15 (iex+sip intersection; each day needs its previous day). Already Argon's in-sample, so searching it costs no held-out data. Every number from stage 1 is information only.
stage_1_search.lines_for_selection: IEX lines and IEX volume (a rule the desk could implement on its live feed). Fills and marks on SIP.

first_rule: F1: the name's first EMPTY-square onset since 09:30 (pitch_open.empty_square)

F2: no earlier minute since 09:30 with ANY square (fast >= -35 and slow >= -35 and |fast-slow| <= 15), the live wr_leg1_refusal check, today's bars only; signal = an empty-square onset with no such earlier minute
volume_rule: V2: pace = (sum v[t-4..t] / 5) / (sum v[09:30..t] / minutes elapsed), the shape of the desk's vol_now_ratio (last 5 minutes vs today's pace); needs t >= 09:35
slow5m_pitch_min_2: on: completed 5m-bar slow %R(28, EMA 3) bar-to-bar change >= +2.0 at t (5m bars built from completed 1m bars, the live wr_slow_5m_refusal rule 2 shape)
grid.fixed: window start 09:45; price cap $150; entry SIP open t+1; exit SIP close entry+14; controls as below.
grid.size: 2 x 2 x 2 x 3 x 2 x 2 x 2 = 192 configurations.

stage_1_search.selection: WINNER = the configuration with the highest day-equal net after 5 bp (IEX lines), among configurations with >= 300 trades and trades on >= 60 days. Ties: more trades, then the configuration string ascending. Selection uses net only; lifts are printed for the top 10 as information.
stage_1_search.argon_as_stated: ARGON = F1, V1, 1.5x, 11:30, [0.5, 5.0], 5m off, $20. If ARGON is the WINNER, the second primary is the runner-up.

stage_2_holdout.primaries: Two tests on IEX lines: WINNER and ARGON (Bonferroni over 2, t >= 2.24). SIP-line versions of both are information only.
stage_2_holdout.sample: Held-out sessions from 2026-01-13 going backward (finding C: 2026-01-14..04-24 is the desk's reserved warehouse_confirm set, already read by other studies, and Argon's exposure to it cannot be checked; it is copied, not refetched, and scored as its own information cell). Blocks of 60 sessions to at most 600 (about 2023-10).
stage_2_holdout.after_10_15: Information only (the liquidity table ends 10/15). Operator said 'proceed' on 10/27 after being told this; not separately confirmed.

fixes.A_power: Before any held-out fetch: run stage 1's controls-only MDE on the in-sample warehouse for WINNER and ARGON (control minus control2 day means only, no trade means), project MDE at 300 days per half, and record it here. Floors per half: >= 150 trades, >= 40 days, MDE <= 8 bp (was 6). If the projection exceeds 8 bp at 600 sessions, the held-out stage still runs to 600 and the verdict is UNDERPOWERED (no means), as the operator was told.
fixes.B_constant: MDE = (2.24 + 0.84) * stdev / sqrt(n_days) = 3.08 x se. Each half needs a lift of about 2.24 x se to pass; power is low by design and this is stated.
fixes.D_definitions: The volume and first-square variants are now grid dimensions (F1/F2, V1/V2) and the winner is fixed before the fetch. 'IEX PASS' reads 'a rule the desk could implement', not 'what the live gate computes'.
fixes.E_missing_minutes: Volume: a minute absent from the feed's file, and a 2-15 minute flat-filled minute, counts as zero volume. Lines use the flat fill as before.
fixes.F_iex_history: One probe request for an IEX session in 2024-01 before any held-out fetch; if IEX is not available that far back, the held-out stage stops where IEX stops (recorded).
fixes.H_scored_sessions: Scored sessions = every fetched held-out session except the extra warm-up session at the oldest end, whether or not it has a trade. Halves by count over those.
fixes.feed_details: Previous close for day change is the SIP last RTH close for both line feeds. The price filter uses the line feed's own close(t) (IEX close for IEX lines), so the IEX rule uses nothing the desk cannot see.

amended.supersedes_in_original: The original single-rule primary, the SIP co-primary, the 6 bp floor and the 2.84 constant are replaced by the above. Pass ladder, controls, statistic, cost (5 bp), canary and score gate are unchanged and apply to each stage-2 primary.
